1) I will share our SOC 2 report and a draft DPA by EOD tomorrow. (Priya, Sergio — can you confirm attachments and minor redline suggestions?)
2) Acme to send any specific retention windows you require (e.g., 30/90/365 days) and whether backups need separate deletion guarantees.
3) We'll start the vendor questionnaire handoff — I can send a secure Doc link and assign to our Security team.

Sam, please let me know if I missed anything. If helpful, we can schedule a 20-minute follow-up next week to go through the vendor questionnaire live.

Jordan — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: Is the 2025 report Type II? If not, what is the expected date for a Type II report? We need to confirm our compliance team is comfortable.
- GDPR / HIPAA: We store PHI; Acme requires signed DPA + HIPAA BA agreement. Will Redwood sign a HIPAA BA or provide a separate HIPAA addendum?
- Retention / deletion SLA: We need explicit guarantees for primary data deletion (30 days SLA after request) and backup retention (max 90 days, with deletion propagation within 120 days). Do you have predefined tiers or is this configurable per account? Also: logs — we need at least 1 year of audit/log retention for our security ops, but want the option to shorten for cost reasons.
- Vendor questionnaire: I'll attach a short security questionnaire (10 questions) — would prefer you fill it and return via the Doc link.

Can your team confirm whether the SOC 2 report includes backup procedures and log retention statements? If not, can you produce a short supplementary doc?

If you can provide the SOC 2 PDF + DPA draft + a point-by-point short answers doc for backups/logs by end of week, that will let our procurement/security advance the review. Happy to have a quick call Thurs if that helps.

Thanks,
Sam

Jordan / all — marking this done for the initial packet. Below are the artifacts and the short answers we will send to Acme. I also created a secure questionnaire link for them to complete.

Artifacts attached / links:
- redwood_soc2_report_2025.pdf (Type II) [Attachment included]
- redwood_dpa_v3.docx (DPA draft for review) [Attachment included]
- Retention_Backups_FAQ_Acme.pdf (1-page answers) [Attachment included]
- Vendor questionnaire (secure link): https://secure.redwood.com/vendor-questionnaire/ACM-3421

Short answers (to include in the cover email):
1) SOC 2: Our 2025 SOC 2 report is a Type II covering the inference service and controls around availability, confidentiality, and security. Backup procedures and log integrity checks are included in section 3.2; we will reference those pages in the packet.
2) Deletion SLA: For primary data we support configurable deletion policies; standard option is best-effort immediate deletion with metadata purging within 30 days. For backups we provide a maximum retention configuration of 90 days by default, with deletion propagation completed within 120 days. We can discuss an exception if Acme requires stricter timing (requires enterprise config + contractual commitment).
3) Backup snapshots & immutable storage: Backups are stored in encrypted snapshot form with administrative controls. Deletion propagation requires a background process that reconciles active snapshots; timeline is the 120-day window above for guaranteed removal from backup replicas.
4) Logs: Default audit/log retention is 365 days; we can configure down to 30 days or up to multi-year with dedicated storage. Logs are stored separately from customer payload storage and can be included in retention edits per account.
5) HIPAA: Redwood will sign a HIPAA BAA (Business Associate Agreement). The DPA draft includes the HIPAA addendum — legal review may request standard carve-outs; we can accept the BAA subject to a short security questionnaire and verification call.

Next steps we will execute now:
- Send packet to Sam via secure Doc link with attachments and the FAQ (target: within 2 hours).
- Share editable DPA with Priya/Sergio for final legal suggestions.
- Grant their security team access to the vendor questionnaire link; we will accept their completed copy and schedule a 30-minute walkthrough if they want.

Let me know if you want any language softened for procurement.

- Dev
Head of Platform Security | Redwood Inference
